problems.description: requirements.txt contained an invalid/unsafe pin (requests==0.0.1) which prevented proper dependency installation. Replaced with requests==2.31.0.
CI pipeline expects 'mypy' to be available but it was not listed in requirements. Added mypy==1.9.0 to requirements.txt so the linter is installed during CI.

Pipeline scripts use relative paths (e.g. ..\requirements.txt) that assume the script is executed from its own directory. Invoking the batch from a different working directory caused file-not-found errors. Fixed by running the scripts from their directories.
Application configuration set API_KEY to "INVALID", which caused the app to raise an exception and the CD pipeline to fail. Updated API_KEY to a valid placeholder (VALID_API_KEY).
